title: Concept: Customer network address recorded in a session payload
description: The last login address of the customer in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The address is a location trail, and a shared or family device makes it a third party's data as well, so exposing it in a profile response is a privacy leak.
applicability: Deployments that render the last login address of the customer into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The address is a location trail, and a shared or family device makes it a third party's data as well, so exposing it in a profile response is a privacy leak.
